   273→// SidecarKzgProofVerified represents the spec verification:
   274→// [REJECT] The sidecar's blob is valid as verified by
   275→// verify_blob_kzg_proof(blob_sidecar.blob, blob_sidecar.kzg_commitment, blob_sidecar.kzg_proof).
   276→func (bv *ROBlobVerifier) SidecarKzgProofVerified() (err error) {
   277→	defer bv.recordResult(RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified, &err)
   278→	if err = bv.verifyBlobCommitment(bv.blob); err != nil {
   279→		log.WithError(err).WithFields(logging.BlobFields(bv.blob)).Debug("Kzg commitment proof verification failed")
   280→		return ErrSidecarKzgProofInvalid
   281→	}
   282→	return nil
   283→}
   284→
   285→// SidecarProposerExpected represents the spec verification:
   286→// [REJECT] The sidecar is proposed by the expected proposer_index for the block's slot
   287→// in the context of the current shuffling (defined by block_header.parent_root/block_header.slot).
   288→// If the proposer_index cannot immediately be verified against the expected shuffling, the sidecar MAY be queued
   289→// for later processing while proposers for the block's branch are calculated -- in such a case do not REJECT, instead IGNORE this message.
   290→func (bv *ROBlobVerifier) SidecarProposerExpected(ctx context.Context) (err error) {
   291→	defer bv.recordResult(RequireSidecarProposerExpected, &err)
   292→	e := slots.ToEpoch(bv.blob.Slot())
   293→	if e > 0 {
   294→		e = e - 1
   295→	}
   296→	r, err := bv.fc.TargetRootForEpoch(bv.blob.ParentRoot(), e)
   297→	if err != nil {
   298→		return errSidecarUnexpectedProposer
   299→	}
   300→	c := &forkchoicetypes.Checkpoint{Root: r, Epoch: e}
   301→	idx, cached := bv.pc.Proposer(c, bv.blob.Slot())
   302→	if !cached {
   303→		pst, err := bv.parentState(ctx)
   304→		if err != nil {
   305→			log.WithError(err).WithFields(logging.BlobFields(bv.blob)).Debug("State replay to parent_root failed")
   306→			return errSidecarUnexpectedProposer
   307→		}
   308→		idx, err = bv.pc.ComputeProposer(ctx, bv.blob.ParentRoot(), bv.blob.Slot(), pst)
   309→		if err != nil {
   310→			log.WithError(err).WithFields(logging.BlobFields(bv.blob)).Debug("Error computing proposer index from parent state")
   311→			return errSidecarUnexpectedProposer
   312→		}
   313→	}
   314→	if idx != bv.blob.ProposerIndex() {
   315→		log.WithError(errSidecarUnexpectedProposer).
   316→			WithFields(logging.BlobFields(bv.blob)).WithField("expectedProposer", idx).
   317→			Debug("Unexpected blob proposer")
   318→		return errSidecarUnexpectedProposer
   319→	}
   320→	return nil
   321→}

   323→func (bv *ROBlobVerifier) parentState(ctx context.Context) (state.BeaconState, error) {
   324→	if bv.parent != nil {
   325→		return bv.parent, nil
   326→	}
   327→	st, err := bv.sr.StateByRoot(ctx, bv.blob.ParentRoot())
   328→	if err != nil {
   329→		return nil, err
   330→	}
   331→	bv.parent = st
   332→	return bv.parent, nil
   333→}

   335→func blobToSignatureData(b blocks.ROBlob) signatureData {
   336→	return signatureData{
   337→		Root:      b.BlockRoot(),
   338→		Parent:    b.ParentRoot(),
   339→		Signature: bytesutil.ToBytes96(b.SignedBlockHeader.Signature),
   340→		Proposer:  b.ProposerIndex(),
   341→		Slot:      b.Slot(),
   342→	}
   343→}

   437→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) epochIdx(epoch primitives.Epoch) int {
   438→	for i := len(ns.entries) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   439→		if ns.entries[i].Epoch <= epoch {
   440→			return i
   441→		}
   442→	}
   443→	return -1
   444→}
   445→
   446→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) Next(epoch primitives.Epoch) NetworkScheduleEntry {
   447→	lastIdx := len(ns.entries) - 1
   448→	idx := ns.epochIdx(epoch)
   449→	if idx < 0 {
   450→		return ns.entries[0]
   451→	}
   452→	if idx == lastIdx {
   453→		return ns.entries[lastIdx]
   454→	}
   455→	return ns.entries[idx+1]
   456→}
   457→
   458→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) LastEntry() NetworkScheduleEntry {
   459→	for i := len(ns.entries) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   460→		if ns.entries[i].Epoch != BeaconConfig().FarFutureEpoch {
   461→			return ns.entries[i]
   462→		}
   463→	}
   464→	return ns.entries[0]
   465→}
   466→
   467→// LastFork is the last full fork (this is used by e2e testing)
   468→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) LastFork() NetworkScheduleEntry {
   469→	for i := len(ns.entries) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   470→		if ns.entries[i].isFork && ns.entries[i].Epoch != BeaconConfig().FarFutureEpoch {
   471→			return ns.entries[i]
   472→		}
   473→	}
   474→	return ns.entries[0]
   475→}
   476→
   477→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) ForEpoch(epoch primitives.Epoch) NetworkScheduleEntry {
   478→	idx := ns.epochIdx(epoch)
   479→	if idx < 0 {
   480→		return ns.entries[0]
   481→	}
   482→	if idx >= len(ns.entries)-1 {
   483→		return ns.entries[len(ns.entries)-1]
   484→	}
   485→	return ns.entries[idx]
   486→}

   488→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) activatedAt(epoch primitives.Epoch) (*NetworkScheduleEntry, bool) {
   489→	ns.mu.RLock()
   490→	defer ns.mu.RUnlock()
   491→	if ns.byEpoch == nil {
   492→		return nil, false
   493→	}
   494→	entry, ok := ns.byEpoch[epoch]
   495→	return entry, ok
   496→}
   497→
   498→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) merge(other *NetworkSchedule) *NetworkSchedule {
   499→	merged := make([]NetworkScheduleEntry, 0, len(ns.entries)+len(other.entries))
   500→	merged = append(merged, ns.entries...)
   501→	merged = append(merged, other.entries...)
   502→	sort.Slice(merged, func(i, j int) bool {
   503→		if merged[i].Epoch == merged[j].Epoch {
   504→			if merged[i].VersionEnum == merged[j].VersionEnum {
   505→				return merged[i].isFork
   506→			}
   507→			return merged[i].VersionEnum < merged[j].VersionEnum
   508→		}
   509→		return merged[i].Epoch < merged[j].Epoch
   510→	})
   511→	return newNetworkSchedule(merged)
   512→}

   514→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) index(e NetworkScheduleEntry) {
   515→	ns.mu.Lock()
   516→	defer ns.mu.Unlock()
   517→	if _, ok := ns.byDigest[e.ForkDigest]; !ok {
   518→		ns.byDigest[e.ForkDigest] = &e
   519→	}
   520→	if _, ok := ns.byVersion[e.ForkVersion]; !ok {
   521→		ns.byVersion[e.ForkVersion] = &e
   522→	}
   523→	if _, ok := ns.byEpoch[e.Epoch]; !ok {
   524→		ns.byEpoch[e.Epoch] = &e
   525→	}
   526→}

   528→func (ns *NetworkSchedule) prepare(b *BeaconChainConfig) error {
   529→	if len(ns.entries) == 0 {
   530→		return errors.New("cannot compute digests for an empty network schedule")
   531→	}
   532→	if !ns.entries[0].isFork {
   533→		return errors.New("cannot compute digests for a network schedule without a fork entry")
   534→	}
   535→	lastFork, err := entryWithForkDigest(ns.entries[0], b)
   536→	if err != nil {
   537→		return err
   538→	}
   539→	ns.entries[0] = lastFork
   540→	ns.index(ns.entries[0])
   541→	var lastBlobs *NetworkScheduleEntry
   542→	for i := 1; i < len(ns.entries); i++ {
   543→		entry := ns.entries[i]
   544→
   545→		if entry.isFork {
   546→			lastFork = entry
   547→		} else {
   548→			entry.ForkVersion = lastFork.ForkVersion
   549→			entry.VersionEnum = lastFork.VersionEnum
   550→		}
   551→
   552→		if entry.MaxBlobsPerBlock > 0 || !entry.isFork {
   553→			entry.BPOEpoch = entry.Epoch
   554→			lastBlobs = &entry
   555→		} else if lastBlobs != nil {
   556→			entry.MaxBlobsPerBlock = lastBlobs.MaxBlobsPerBlock
   557→			entry.BPOEpoch = lastBlobs.BPOEpoch
   558→		}
   559→
   560→		entry, err = entryWithForkDigest(entry, b)
   561→		if err != nil {
   562→			return err
   563→		}
   564→		ns.entries[i] = entry
   565→		ns.index(entry)
   566→	}
   567→	return nil
   568→}

   570→func entryWithForkDigest(entry NetworkScheduleEntry, b *BeaconChainConfig) (NetworkScheduleEntry, error) {
   571→	root, err := computeForkDataRoot(entry.ForkVersion, b.GenesisValidatorsRoot)
   572→	if err != nil {
   573→		return entry, err
   574→	}
   575→	entry.ForkDigest = to4(root[:])
   576→	if entry.Epoch < b.FuluForkEpoch {
   577→		return entry, nil
   578→	}
   579→	if entry.MaxBlobsPerBlock > math.MaxUint32 {
   580→		return entry, fmt.Errorf("max blobs per block exceeds maximum uint32 value")
   581→	}
   582→	hb := make([]byte, 16)
   583→	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(hb[0:8], uint64(entry.BPOEpoch))
   584→	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(hb[8:], entry.MaxBlobsPerBlock)
   585→	bpoHash := hash.Hash(hb)
   586→	entry.ForkDigest[0] = entry.ForkDigest[0] ^ bpoHash[0]
   587→	entry.ForkDigest[1] = entry.ForkDigest[1] ^ bpoHash[1]
   588→	entry.ForkDigest[2] = entry.ForkDigest[2] ^ bpoHash[2]
   589→	entry.ForkDigest[3] = entry.ForkDigest[3] ^ bpoHash[3]
   590→	return entry, nil
   591→}

   595→func initForkSchedule(b *BeaconChainConfig) *NetworkSchedule {
   596→	return newNetworkSchedule([]NetworkScheduleEntry{
   597→		{Epoch: b.GenesisEpoch, isFork: true, ForkVersion: to4(b.GenesisForkVersion), VersionEnum: version.Phase0},
   598→		{Epoch: b.AltairForkEpoch, isFork: true, ForkVersion: to4(b.AltairForkVersion), VersionEnum: version.Altair},
   599→		{Epoch: b.BellatrixForkEpoch, isFork: true, ForkVersion: to4(b.BellatrixForkVersion), VersionEnum: version.Bellatrix},
   600→		{Epoch: b.CapellaForkEpoch, isFork: true, ForkVersion: to4(b.CapellaForkVersion), VersionEnum: version.Capella},
   601→		{Epoch: b.DenebForkEpoch, isFork: true, ForkVersion: to4(b.DenebForkVersion), MaxBlobsPerBlock: uint64(b.DeprecatedMaxBlobsPerBlock), VersionEnum: version.Deneb},
   602→		{Epoch: b.ElectraForkEpoch, isFork: true, ForkVersion: to4(b.ElectraForkVersion), MaxBlobsPerBlock: uint64(b.DeprecatedMaxBlobsPerBlockElectra), VersionEnum: version.Electra},
   603→		{Epoch: b.FuluForkEpoch, isFork: true, ForkVersion: to4(b.FuluForkVersion), VersionEnum: version.Fulu},
   604→	})
   605→}

   607→func initBPOSchedule(b *BeaconChainConfig) *NetworkSchedule {
   608→	sort.Slice(b.BlobSchedule, func(i, j int) bool {
   609→		return b.BlobSchedule[i].Epoch < b.BlobSchedule[j].Epoch
   610→	})
   611→	entries := make([]NetworkScheduleEntry, len(b.BlobSchedule))
